title_en: TABLE 5.11: NUMBER OF JOB SEEKERS REGISTERED BY AGE GROUP AND SEX, 2011-2015

source: މައުލޫމާތު ދެއްވި ފަރާތް: މިނިސްޓްރީ އޮފް ޔޫތް އެންޑް ސްޕޯޓްސް
notes: Note: The registered job seekers are taken from vazeefaage dhaftharu website (www.yes.mv)
